references.text: The Lord says to Aaron that the Levites shall have no inheritance in the land, for the Lord himself is their inheritance
The Levites shall have no inheritance among the children of Israel; the tithe is given to them as an inheritance
Levitical priests shall have no inheritance with Israel; the Lord is their inheritance
Only the tribe of Levi received no inheritance; the Lord's offerings are their inheritance, as he had said
The tribe of Levi received no inheritance; the Lord, the God of Israel, is their inheritance
The Levites received no portion in the land, only cities to live in and pasturelands
Ezekiel confirms that the Lord himself is the priests' inheritance, and they shall have no property in Israel
The Lord is the psalmist's lot and his cup; the Lord holds fast his inheritance
God is the psalmist's rock and his portion forever, an expression that the Lord is the believer's inheritance
